articles.title: When Numbers Speak: Aligning Textual Numerals and Visual Instances in Text-to-Video Diffusion Models

articles.summary: Generalization under distribution shift remains a central bottleneck for closed-loop autonomous driving. articles.title: FIT: A Large-Scale Dataset for Fit-Aware Virtual Try-On
articles.summary: Given a person and a garment image, virtual try-on (VTO) aims to synthesize a realistic image of the person wearing the garment, while preserving their original pose and identity. Although recent VTO methods excel at visualizing garment appearance, they largely overlook a crucial aspect of the try-on experience: the accuracy of garment fit -- for example, depicting how an extra-large shirt looks on an extra-small person. articles.title: UniversalVTG: A Universal and Lightweight Foundation Model for Video Temporal Grounding
articles.summary: Video temporal grounding (VTG) is typically tackled with dataset-specific models that transfer poorly across domains and query styles. articles.summary: We tackle the problem of sparse novel view synthesis (NVS) using video diffusion models; given $K$ ($\approx 5$) multi-view images of a scene and their camera poses, we predict the view from a target camera pose. articles.title: The Difference Between Junior and Senior Engineers Isn't the Code They Write
articles.summary: After 4 years of shipping production systems across AI platforms, mobile apps, and AWS serverless backends, I've noticed a pattern. The engineers who ship the fastest and break the least aren't the ones writing the cleverest code. They're the ones who set up the system before writing any code at all.
